mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a persistent monetary policy effect.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a supply shock that may cause stagflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 55% of instances where INDPRO falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll gain exceeding 200,000 (PAYEMS) signals strong economic growth and potential inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS monthly change > 200.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a supply shock (e.g., manufacturing slowdown) that may lead to stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 55% of instances where INDPRO falls and HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the market expects higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
